connector.name: Nexus Finance
connector.registryDescription: Nexus Finance API - compliance audit, VaR/RWA risk, market quotes and case management.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the djtellado account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NEXUS_FINANCE_API_KEY
env.description: Nexus Finance API key (must start with nf_). Obtain from your dashboard at https://app.nexusquantum.finance

env.name: NEXUS_FINANCE_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Nexus Finance API. Defaults to https://app.nexusquantum.finance
